newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne shareholders might get Optus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne shareholders might get Optus.

text.p: Transport, security and health care group Mayne Nickless Ltd said on Thursday it might market its 25 percent stake in Optus Communications to Mayne shareholders as one of five divestment options.
"That particular option would see our existing shareholders being directly able to attribute value to their Optus investment, yes," managing director Bob Dalziel told reporters.
He declined to comment on whether this option would leave shareholders with tradeable securities on the Australian stock Exchange.
"In one sense, it is a less palatable option because it is complex and time-consuming and will not be completed until July," Dalziel said.
"It would not be an unattractive option to our shareholders who have expressed their interest in Optus."
Dalziel earlier said a float of the Optus stake was unrealistic before its July/June goal of exiting the investment. He declined to comment on the other three options.
Mayne has said it wants to sell the Optus stake in order to focus on its core business.
